source_instruction: i want to purchase synthetic hair topper that are 18 inch long and have 4 clips of dark blonde hair with bangs.
query: Oh man, I swear the barista at my usual corner café recognized me the second I walked in this morning, and they already had my iced oat milk latte with an extra shot and a dash of cinnamon sitting on the counter before I even opened my mouth to order. The best part? They’d slipped one of those little lemon shortbread cookies I love onto the saucer for free, saying they’d baked an extra batch that morning and thought I’d want one. I sat at the wobbly little table by the window for ten minutes just people watching, too—saw a golden retriever trot by wearing a tiny neon rain jacket even though it wasn’t raining, and a group of teens doing a terrible but very enthusiastic choreographed dance on the sidewalk for a school project. It was such a silly, nice little start to the day that it almost made me forget I ran out of my favorite dry shampoo last night and had to make a run to the store to restock. Hey, I’m looking through the hair loss products section for a topper made of yak hair, y’know? I need the one that’s that length I always grab, and I don’t wanna spend more than $60 on it total. Can you pull up the options that fit that stuff for me? Wait, make sure it’s the regular clip and bangs style I usually go for too, yeah?
